[
  {"step":1,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/fwupd/plugins/dfu-csr/data/upgrade.tdc.gz","function":"<global>","line":1,"var":"input file bytes","code":"Compressed TDC firmware image used as the attacker-controlled input","note":"The crafted firmware blob is the raw input consumed by fwupd's CSR DFU parser."},
  {"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/fwupd/plugins/dfu-csr/fu-dfu-csr-firmware.c","function":"fu_dfu_csr_firmware_parse","line":41,"var":"stream","code":"st_hdr = fu_struct_dfu_csr_file_parse_stream(stream, offset, error);","note":"The parser reads the file header from the input stream and extracts the declared firmware length field."},
  {"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/fwupd/plugins/dfu-csr/fu-dfu-csr-firmware.c","function":"fu_dfu_csr_firmware_parse","line":45,"var":"self->total_sz","code":"self->total_sz = fu_struct_dfu_csr_file_get_file_len(st_hdr);","note":"The attacker-controlled file_len value is stored as the firmware's total size and later used to drive upload progress and chunk handling."},
  {"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/fwupd/plugins/dfu-csr/fu-dfu-csr-device.c","function":"fu_dfu_csr_device_upload","line":181,"var":"total_sz","code":"total_sz = fu_dfu_csr_firmware_get_total_sz(FU_DFU_CSR_FIRMWARE(firmware));","note":"The parsed length is propagated into the upload path as the expected total size for the firmware image."},
  {"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/fwupd/plugins/dfu-csr/fu-dfu-csr-device.c","function":"fu_dfu_csr_device_upload_chunk","line":169,"var":"buf + FU_STRUCT_DFU_CSR_COMMAND_HEADER_SIZE","code":"return g_bytes_new(buf + FU_STRUCT_DFU_CSR_COMMAND_HEADER_SIZE, sizeof(buf) - FU_STRUCT_DFU_CSR_COMMAND_HEADER_SIZE);","note":"Each device response is converted into a GBytes view over the command payload, so the code later trusts the payload length derived from the header."},
  {"step":6,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/fwupd/plugins/dfu-csr/fu-dfu-csr-device.c","function":"fu_dfu_csr_device_upload","line":205,"var":"chunk_sz","code":"if (chunk_sz < 64 - FU_STRUCT_DFU_CSR_COMMAND_HEADER_SIZE) break;","note":"The loop termination depends on the chunk size reported by the device, so a malformed or truncated final chunk can alter how much data is accumulated."},
  {"step":7,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/fwupd/plugins/dfu-csr/fu-dfu-csr-device.c","function":"fu_dfu_csr_device_upload","line":212,"var":"chunks","code":"return fu_dfu_utils_bytes_join_array(chunks);","note":"The collected chunks are concatenated into a single firmware blob; if the earlier size bookkeeping is inconsistent with the actual payloads, the join step can read past the end of a chunk buffer and trigger the heap-buffer-overflow READ."}
]
